issues.description: ExcellenceLand constructor parameter order in the solution does not follow the problem statement/UML ordering rule. The statement requires constructor parameters to match the UML attribute order. UML lists ExcellenceLand attributes as excellencyLevel, excellentEnough, and the rides association (List<Ride> rides). However, the solution defines `public ExcellenceLand(List<Ride> rides, boolean excellentEnough, double excellencyLevel)`, reversing the required order and likely breaking tests or confusing students about the expected signature.
issues.suggestedFix: Change the solution (and any tests, if applicable) to use constructor parameter order matching the UML and stated rule, e.g. `public ExcellenceLand(double excellencyLevel, boolean excellentEnough, List<Ride> rides)`.
